name: forum
description: Discussion/forum/community product archetype with topics, replies, categories, profiles and moderation-ready structure.
journeys: register -> browse category -> open topic -> reply
guidelines: Thread readability and pagination matter more than decorative dashboard chrome.
Keep author identity, timestamps and reply hierarchy explicit.
definition_of_done: Users can create topics and replies with authorization checks.
Topic lists/detail pages are readable and responsive.
Search and reply notifications exist unless explicitly deferred.
